### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Limit assessment statements to direct diagnoses, explicit connections, or contributing factors *stated by the provider* in the transcript; do not infer clinical relationships or contributing factors not explicitly discussed.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A-Section]: Assessment statements must *only* include direct diagnoses, explicit connections, or contributing factors *verbatim stated by the provider* in the transcript; *never* infer clinical relationships or contributing factors not explicitly discussed.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
